ADMINISTER.name: Administer Jira
ADMINISTER.description: Create and administer projects, issue types, fields, workflows, and schemes for all projects. Users with this permission can perform most administration tasks, except: managing users, importing data, and editing system email settings.

MOVE_ISSUES.name: Move Issues
MOVE_ISSUES.description: Ability to move issues between projects or between workflows of the same project (if applicable). Note the user can only move issues to a project they have the create permission for.

DELETE_ALL_COMMENTS.name: Delete All Comments
DELETE_ALL_COMMENTS.description: Ability to delete all comments made on issues.

CREATE_ATTACHMENTS.name: Create Attachments
CREATE_ATTACHMENTS.description: Users with this permission may create attachments.
